question: Approve this task to enter ideation: embed the stage-report protocol in the dispatch build artifact so Pi-dispatched workers write complete stage reports on real (non-self-describing) dispatches, and add a non-self-describing live lane that closes the tautology the current smoke tests run on?

artifacts.summary: Pi-dispatched ensigns miss the required ## Stage Report on real dispatches because dispatch build's artifact body omits the stage-report protocol while its First action block falsely claims it carries it. Embed the protocol (sourced from ensign-shared-core.md) in the artifact body for every host, and add a non-self-describing live lane that exercises the real mode the current self-describing smoke checklists skip.
